name: theme-readme-win
description: Box theming (Windows): copies the README attachment ($README_FILENAME) to C:\Users\Public\Documents\huitzilopochtli\README.html (every interactive account sees the Public profile; the handbook .lnk points here, off the Desktop). Auto-created idempotently by boxbuilder/vulndb.py; do not hand-edit the name.
script:
if (-not $README_FILENAME) { Write-Output 'README_FILENAME not set; nothing to do'; exit 0 }
$src = Join-Path (Get-Location) $README_FILENAME
if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { throw "README attachment $src not found in the working directory" }
# Off the Desktop (which stays at the forensics answers file + shortcuts): the
# handbook .lnk points here. Public Documents is readable by every account.
$mirror = Join-Path $env:PUBLIC 'Documents\huitzilopochtli'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $mirror | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Force $src (Join-Path $mirror 'README.html')
